purpose: Transaction list/form screens and gatepass window wired to shared TxnDocumentService APIs.

key_files.GatepassPage.tsx: Inward/outward tabs with live lists and draft create
key_files.RequisitionPage.tsx: Store Requisition list + full form (Department/Employee variants, attachments, approvals, approve/reject)
key_files.RequisitionItemLines.tsx: Editable requisition line grid with item auto-fill and live available-stock lookup
key_files.GrnPage.tsx: Goods Receipt Note list + full form (header, quantity summary, sign-off); saving posts accepted qty to stock
key_files.GrnItemLines.tsx: Editable GRN line grid with received/accepted/rejected split, per-line amount and live available-stock lookup
key_files.lineGrid.tsx: Shared line-grid primitives — base line shape, cell styles, item index and the race-safe available-stock lookup hook
key_files.txnLookups.ts: Shared master-list hooks, option label helpers and inline quick-add configs for employee/location/vendor/general-master values
